subject: ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — Veridian Health opportunity
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@veridianhealth.com>, AWS ACE Team <aws-ace@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — Veridian Health opportunity

Hi Priya / AWS ACE team,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. Veridian Health is ready to move forward with ACE registration so we can get co-sell motion support for their pilot. Quick summary of the opportunity: 
- Account: Veridian Health (national regional health system)
- Use case: inference for discharge summarization and clinical decision support; sensitive PHI routing to Redwood Private VPC
- Pilot ask: 6-week proof-of-value, up to 5M tokens/month during pilot window; likely US-only region initially

Action items we need to push ACE intake:
1) ACE intake form + required attachments from AWS (app listing, security checklist)
2) Signed NDA between Veridian and AWS/Redwood (Veridian requested template)
3) Introduce our PDM/PSM pair so AWS can assign co-sell resources and map go-to-market assets

Kimberly I’m looping you in — can you own PDM/PSM intro and confirm who from Redwood will be primary PDM/PSM for this account?

Priya — what documents do you need from our side to complete the ACE registration? Also happy to slot a 30–60 minute handshake w/ PDM/PSM + Veridian + AWS next week.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: veridian-MAP-20260115.pdf (mutual action plan), ace-intake-form-placeholder.xlsx (will complete on request)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS ACE Team <aws-ace@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — Veridian Health opportunity

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear summary. Veridian is excited to move quickly. A few notes from our side:
- We can sign a mutual NDA this week (sending internal legal contact in a follow-up)
- Pilot timeline: target kickoff 2/1/2026, with an internal security review required prior to start
- We prefer a single POC for redwood PM/ops and would like AWS to map any required Marketplace listing steps so procurement has a clear checklist

I attached the initial MAP (veridian-MAP-20260115.pdf) — that contains proposed milestones and procurement timeline.

Available times for the handshake call next week: Mon 1/19 10–12 PT, Tue 1/20 13–16 PT. Let me know what works.

Best,
Priya
Priya Shah
Senior Director, Digital Strategy | Veridian Health
priya.shah@veridianhealth.com
From: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay.reddy@amazon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: AWS ACE Team <aws-ace@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 12:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — Veridian Health opportunity

Hi Marcus / Priya,

Great to see momentum. To get Veridian into the ACE pipeline we need: 
1) Completed ACE intake spreadsheet (I’ve attached the required template)
2) High-level solution diagram and lead contact for PDM/PSM (we assign resources based on contact & region)
3) Signed NDA (if you prefer we can take your template or provide ours)

I’ve opened a quick intake ticket on our side — please complete the attached intake form and upload to the provided DocuSign/Handshake link: https://aws.amazon.com/handshake/ace-intake/VERIDIAN-DOCS (placeholder).

Once intake is received I’ll route to the regional PDM and PSM. Happy to join the handshake call — I’m available Tue 1/20 14–16 PT.

— Sanjay
Sanjay Reddy
AWS ACE | Partner Solutions
sanjay.reddy@amazon.com

Kimberly / Aditya — forwarding the thread. Quick asks from Redwood side so we can present a clean intake to AWS: 
- Kimberly: confirm the PDM and PSM names you want assigned for this account (region: US West)
- Aditya: will you own the technical kickoff and pilot sizing (6-week PoV, expected peak concurrency)? Need a short bullet list of compute and data isolation requirements for the ACE intake (private VPC + HSM if possible).

Priya / Sanjay — I’ll get you the completed intake + a short solution diagram by end of day Friday.
